title: Developer Spark Program: onboarding initiative for SDKs, Docs, and Quickstarts
creator: Priya Shah
description: Run a 6-week pilot (Developer Spark) to validate a repeatable onboarding funnel for new users that touches SDK adoption, quickstarts, and docs. Deliverables include a cohort curriculum, instrumented funnels (analytics), a content pack for engineers (sample apps + recipes), and a rollout playbook for handoff to Grow/GTM.
acceptance_criteria: Cohort curriculum published with 4 guided quickstarts across Node/Python/Go and one reference app
Analytics dashboard shows funnel metrics (activation, time-to-first-call, retention) for pilot cohort
At least 30 pilot signups and 12 completions of the end-to-end quickstart
Handoff playbook completed with clear ownership, runbook steps, and templates for future cohorts
tasks: Define cohort syllabus and learning objectives (week 1)
Build and stabilize Node/Python/Go quickstarts and reference app (week 1-3)
Instrument metrics: signup form, API onboarding, first successful call, first paid usage (week 2)
Run internal dry-run with Solutions and Developer Relations (week 3)
Recruit external pilot participants (target 30) and run cohort (week 4-9)
Collect qualitative feedback & perform post-cohort interviews (week 10)
Compile playbook and handoff materials for Grow/GTM (week 11)
Iterate on docs and quickstarts based on signal (week 12)
Prepare retrospective and roadmap recommendations (end of pilot)
updates: 2026-01-20: Kickoff meeting — agreed scope (3 quickstarts + 1 reference app) and success metrics. Action: engineering to provide baseline SDK bundles by 2026-02-05. (notes: https://confluence.redwood/DEVX/SPARK-KICKOFF)

2026-02-04: Engineering spike complete — Node + Python quickstarts functional; Go quickstart delayed due to HTTP client inconsistency in SDK. Decision: ship Node/Python for pilot, add Go in follow-up. Assigned ENG-40210 to track Go client fix.

2026-02-14: Analytics plan approved. Events: signup_started, signup_completed, first_api_call, quickstart_completed, followup_survey_sent. Dashboard prototype: https://metabase.redwood/dashboards/132-spark-cohort

2026-02-28: Internal dry-run with DevRel — found friction in auth flow (API key vs. OAuth). Short-term fix: add step-by-step auth doc and CLI snippet; long-term: consider simplified ephemeral keys. Created ENG-40456 for ephemeral keys exploration.

2026-03-05: Participant recruitment started — targeted mailing to recent signups and existing sandbox users. Current interest: 42 signups (target 30). Outreach playbook: https://drive.redwood.com/DEVX/Spark/RecruitmentPlaybook.pdf
2026-03-09: UX review completed for quickstart flow; PM/Design approved minimal layout changes for tutorial page. DES-7123 to implement copy adjustments and code sandbox embed.
metrics: Activation rate (first successful API call / signups) — target 45%
Conversion to paid within 30 days — target 5%
risks: Auth friction reduces activation; mitigation: provide CLI snippets and consider ephemeral keys (ENG-40456)
Insufficient engineering capacity for cross-language quickstarts; mitigation: scope to Node/Python for pilot and schedule Go next sprint
Analytics instrumentation gaps could undercount activation; mitigation: QA events in staging and synthetic load tests
Recruitment fails to hit target — mitigation: extend outreach to partners and incent signups with cloud credits
